changes.sourceEnglish: Beans climb the maize, and store as protein.

changes.semanticRationale: The accepted change is only the ordinary connector and→na. Keep the technical/protein wording `store as protein` byte-exact; do not expand the sentence or certify its grammar.

changes.sourceEnglish: A staple earns its place because it feeds the household beyond the day of harvest.

reviewCaveats: Unreviewed source-bound machine draft; not fluent-speaker approved.

No primary-source whole-phrase approval is claimed; semantic proposal only.
